releasePlan.notes: No prerequisites. Control path restores the original showOverlay('GALACTIC DEFENDER', ...) call that was removed by the PR; v1 path shows the new callsign login form. The invaders-shooter-sprite flag is a peer (not a prerequisite) — its context changes when setPlayerName calls ldClient.identify() on login, which is expected and safe.
